meta_description: Pick-A-Lock Ltd is Leicester's trusted emergency locksmith. Fast response, fair prices, no damage. Locked out? Call us now.
hero_subhead: We arrive in under 45 minutes, any time of day or night. Fast, damage-free entry guaranteed.
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to routine lock changes, we handle every lockout, break-in repair, and security upgrade with care and speed.

services.title: Emergency Lockout
services.desc: Locked yourself out? We'll get you back inside quickly and without damage to your door or frame. Available 24/7, day or night.

services.title: Lock Installation & Upgrade
services.desc: Modern multipoint locks and high-security cylinders fitted fast. We advise on the best protection for your home or business.

services.title: Break-In Repairs
services.desc: Forced locks replaced and damage assessed. We secure your property immediately so you can feel safe again.

services.title: UPVC Door Lock Repair
services.desc: Snapped keys, stiff locks, and handle problems fixed on the spot. Most jobs done in one visit without needing a new door.

services.title: Commercial Lock Changes
services.desc: Offices, shops, and rental properties serviced swiftly. We can re-key multiple locks to new master keys for convenience.

services.title: Safe & Vault Opening
services.desc: Forgotten combination or lost keys? We open safes and vaults with specialist tools, preserving the lock where possible.

about_pullquote: I've built this on trust: fair prices, no damage, and genuine care for every customer.
about_para_1: Pick-A-Lock Ltd has been serving Leicester homes and businesses for 18 years. Started by a locksmith who was tired of seeing customers ripped off by cowboys, we've earned a reputation for honest pricing, swift response, and real expertise. DBS checked and fully insured, we handle everything from midnight lockouts to commercial security upgrades.
about_para_2: Our customers come back to us because we answer the phone, we turn up when we say we will, and we never overcharge. Whether you're locked out in the freezing cold or planning a rental property refresh, we treat your space with respect and your wallet with fairness. That's why the vast majority of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Sunday morning with no spare key anywhere. Rang Pick-A-Lock and a bloke called Mark arrived within an hour. He got me in without any fuss or damage, charged a fair price, and even advised me on better locks. Absolute lifesaver. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had a break-in attempt on my rental property. Called them in a panic and they came same day, replaced the damaged lock and gave me a full security report. Professional, honest, and didn't try to upsell me stuff I didn't need. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: My son got his key stuck in the door lock and was in tears. Pick-A-Lock arrived quickly, removed the key safely without harming anything, and sorted a new lock the same afternoon. The team were really patient with him and didn't charge extra for the rush. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Jennifer K.
